Usage: agent [options] [command] [prompt...]

Cursor Agent CLI. When no command is specified, starts an interactive
agent session in the terminal.

Options:
  -v, --version              Output the version number
  -h, --help                 Display help for command
  -p, --print                Print responses (non-interactive; not a TTY session)
  --output-format <format>   text|json|stream-json (only with --print)
  --resume [chatId]          Resume a chat session
  --continue                 Continue the previous session (alias for --resume=-1)
  --model <model>            Model to use
  --mode <mode>              Set agent mode: plan or ask
  --workspace <dir>          Workspace directory to use

Commands:
  login                      Authenticate with Cursor
  logout                     Sign out and clear stored authentication
  status                     View authentication status
  whoami                     View authentication status
  about                      Display version, system, and account info
  ls                         Open previous chats
  resume                     Resume the latest chat session
  create-chat                Create a new empty chat and return its ID
  help [command]             Display help for command

Auth note: subscription login is `agent login` / `agent status`.
This CLI does not document `auth status`, SessionStart hooks, or a
host-relayed provider session id for interactive terminal mode.
Quota is not exposed by a local subscription CLI status command.
